material.scopeLabel: Nine source-reviewed Ag2Se routes: Buschmann 1998 has one aqueous double-jet and three concentration-specific microemulsion routes; Tan 2006 has three stages of one photolysis sequence (10 min Ag@Ag2Se and 60 min incipient-hollow mixed Ag/Ag2Se, then 90 min hollow Ag2Se). Chan 2007 exchanges externally prepared CdSe nanocrystals to Ag2Se; its chip XAS, separate SI XRD specimen, and stopped-flow kinetic comparisons have different sample assignments. Buschmann Figure 4 has no variant-specific assignment. Yao 2009 adds a fully exchanged Ag2Se aerogel from a preformed CdSe gel; partial CdSe/Ag2Se wet-gel and PbSe/CuSe outcomes are separate variants, not constituents of this final Ag2Se aerogel.
